question.text: As per the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 cited in the chapter, 'Retail Individual Investor' means an individual who applies or bids for specified securities up to a value of not more than:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook quotes the SEBI ICDR 2018 definition: 'Retail individual investor' means an individual investor who applies or bids for specified securities for a value of not more than INR 2 lakh. The Trap: INR 1 lakh, INR 5 lakh and INR 10 lakh are not the ICDR Retail Individual Investor threshold. Note: The workbook directly supports the INR 2 lakh ICDR retail individual investor definition. Older-threshold, SIF, downstream public-issue, and cross-exam commentary have been removed as not directly supported.
